headerDisplay:
A `http` plugin with support of webhooks for homebridge.

The plugin gets its states from any system that is calling the url to trigger a state change.

Currently supports `contact`, `motion`, `occupancy`, `smoke`, `switches`, `push buttons`, `doorbells`, `lights` (only on/off and brightness), `temperature`, `humidity`, `thermostats`, `co2sensors`, and `leak` sensors.

state_mode.title: State source
state_mode.description: Optimistic assumes completion after HTTP command success; external waits for feedback for current state. Applies only to this accessory. If omitted, defaults to optimistic unless the legacy external_state option is true.

startup_state_policy.title: Startup state
startup_state_policy.description: Applies only to this accessory. If omitted: external waits for fresh feedback, optimistic uses cache/defaults. Waiting may appear as Updating or No Response in Home until feedback arrives. Cached values are unverified.

notification_policy.title: Explicit notifications
notification_policy.description: Allow explicit lets a client reaffirm unchanged values. It never repeats commands.

notification_min_interval_ms.title: Duplicate notification interval (ms)
notification_min_interval_ms.description: Minimum interval per field for identical explicit events. Real changes always propagate.

request_timeout_ms.title: Command deadline (ms)
request_timeout_ms.description: Total HTTP command deadline. Commands are never retried or redirected.

response_max_bytes.title: Maximum command response bytes
response_max_bytes.description: Stop reading a larger response and report failure; do not retry.

external_state.title: Legacy external-state alias
external_state.description: Migration alias for state_mode. If both are specified, they must agree.

feedback_timeout_seconds.title: Feedback timeout (seconds)
feedback_timeout_seconds.description: 0 disables expiry. Otherwise only a valid current-state report renews freshness. Commands and status reads do not. Choose longer than the reporting interval plus network delay. Works with legacy webhooks and v1.

obstruction_monitoring.title: Monitor obstruction feedback
obstruction_monitoring.description: Requires a real source reporting blocked and clear. Starts unavailable until its first report, independently of door state. Does not remove the required HomeKit characteristic when disabled.

obstruction_timeout_seconds.title: Obstruction timeout (seconds)
obstruction_timeout_seconds.description: Requires obstruction monitoring. 0 disables expiry after the first report. Only obstruction reports renew this timer; door-state heartbeats do not.

state_api_token.title: State API token
state_api_token.description: Optional shared credential for clients sending state reports INTO this platform’s HTTP server. Currently grants access to all garage/lock state endpoints on this platform; the accessory ID in the URL selects the device. It is not sent to device command URLs. Generate 32–256 random URL-safe characters. Clients send X-Webhooks-Token; existing Basic authentication also applies. Leave unchanged when an integration uses it.

webhook_response_mode.title: Legacy webhook response format
webhook_response_mode.description: Default: legacy, for existing clients. Legacy returns previous values; applied returns typed resulting garage/lock state and notification outcomes. This choice does not affect v1 API responses or other accessory families.

log_level.title: Log level
log_level.description: Inherit uses the platform choice and Homebridge logging. Debug always respects Homebridge/child-bridge debug enablement. No request or response payloads are logged.

extra_redaction_keys.description: Optional custom secret field names. Mandatory credential redaction cannot be disabled.
